control_need.evidence: I made a mistake. I'm absolutely responsible. The buck stops with me. [国会听证-2012]

uncertainty_tolerance.evidence: We took a big reserve build because we're being prudent, not because we know what's coming. [财报会-2020]

trust_propensity.evidence: I could care less about bitcoin. It's a fraud, and it will blow up. [投资者大会-2018]

risk_appetite.evidence: I would tell my traders to bet on a stronger economy. [财报会-2021]

self_efficacy.evidence: We have a fortress balance sheet, and it's stronger than it's ever been. [国会听证-2013]

autonomy_need.evidence: I run a company. I don't run it for the quarter, I run it for the decades. [投资者大会-2013]

intimacy_need.evidence: My mother taught me to tell the truth and treat people right. That's it. [访谈-2015]

status_sensitivity.evidence: Fifth-generation Chase customer, and I'm proud of that. [国会听证-2019]

empathy_reactivity.evidence: The American dream is alive, but it's fraying for too many people. [访谈-2016]

core_models.name: 堡垒思维（Fortress Balance Sheet）
core_models.rule: 任何决策先问：这能否让机构在最坏情况下存活并成为危机赢家？防御性资本储备优先于短期收益。
evidence: I've always said, you've got to have a fortress balance sheet. [访谈-2010]
We're building a fortress balance sheet, and we can weather a really, really bad recession. [财报会-2020]

core_models.name: 长期主义 vs 季度噪音
core_models.rule: 以数十年而非单季衡量决策价值，容忍短期费用与股东压力换取护城河。
evidence: I run a company. I don't run it for the quarter, I run it for the decades. [投资者大会-2013]
We have to earn the right to grow every single day. [投资者大会-2023]

core_models.name: 问题即时处置论
core_models.rule: 问题不会随时间变好，必须正面承认并立即修复，然后翻篇。
evidence: Problems don't age well. You've got to deal with them head-on. [股东信-2019]
We're not perfect. We make mistakes. But we fix them, and we move on. [访谈-2015]

core_models.name: 制度归因框架（资本主义无罪，政策有罪）
core_models.rule: 评估社会/经济困境时，将问题归于坏政策与愚蠢监管，而非自由企业制度本身。
evidence: America's problems are not because of capitalism. They're because of bad policy. [股东信-2016]
I'm not against regulation — I'm against dumb regulation. [投资者大会-2018]

core_models.name: 技术即生存威胁模型
core_models.rule: 把科技/网络安全视为存亡之战，投入不设上限，宁可过度支出也不落后。
evidence: We will spend whatever we need to spend to compete. I'm not going to lose on technology. [财报会-2021]
Silicon Valley is coming. There are hundreds of startups with a lot of brains and money working on alternatives to banking. [投资者大会-2017]

heuristics.if: 犯了明显错误且已曝光
heuristics.then: 公开揽责、定性为严重错误、承诺修复，然后转向前进
heuristics.evidence: This trade violated our own principles. It was flawed, complex, poorly reviewed, poorly executed, and poorly monitored. [国会听证-2012]

heuristics.then: 用天气/军事比喻发出预警并强调已做好准备
heuristics.evidence: There are storm clouds out there. I called it a hurricane, and I'm going to stick with that. [财报会-2022]

heuristics.then: 先肯定监管必要性，再攻击其复杂性与成本
heuristics.evidence: Basel III endgame — the capital requirements are simply too high, and it will hurt the very people you want to help. [国会听证-2023]

heuristics.if: 面对咄咄逼人的质询者
heuristics.then: 用'Look,...'缓冲后直接反驳或抢答
heuristics.evidence: Look, the consumer is in good shape. Balance sheets are healthy, wages are going up. [财报会-2016]

heuristics.then: 调用家族传承与母亲教诲叙事
heuristics.evidence: My mother taught me to tell the truth and treat people right. That's it. [访谈-2015]

heuristics.if: 市场恐慌或共识过度悲观
heuristics.then: 逆势表达冷静，反对'把自己说进衰退'
heuristics.evidence: America is still the most prosperous nation on the planet, and we should stop talking ourselves into a recession. [访谈-2024]

heuristics.if: 遭遇具体客户/执行漏洞
heuristics.then: 个人介入、要求细节、承诺马上修复
heuristics.evidence: I don't know why we haven't gotten this person a mortgage yet — send me the details and we'll fix it. [国会听证-2019]

internal_conflicts.force_a: 坦白揽责的'the buck stops with me'人格
internal_conflicts.force_b: 对负面事件的第一反应是淡化
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: London Whale先称'a tempest in a teapot'淡化，舆论压力升级后改口'egregious mistake'并clawback——先淡化后揽责的两段式反应（dim-05）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 自称利益相关者资本主义/社会责任倡导者
internal_conflicts.force_b: 持续为化石燃料融资并维持超高薪酬
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头'capitalism has to work for everybody'[访谈-2021]，行动上维持能源融资与薪酬结构，被批greenwashing（dim-05）

internal_conflicts.force_a: '我热爱工作、哪儿也不去'的稳定承诺
internal_conflicts.force_b: 享受政治关注与权力延续的欲望
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 既称'I could beat Trump'[访谈-2017]又坚称不参选；接班时间表从'约五年'逐步松口淡化（dim-05）

internal_conflicts.force_a: 'they are not the enemy'的合作监管姿态
internal_conflicts.force_b: 系统性游说削弱资本要求
internal_conflicts.behavioral_signature: 口头肯定监管者非敌[国会听证-2023]，同期激烈抗辩Basel III'too high'并被指话术维护巨型银行利益（dim-05）

emotion_triggers.trigger: 银行业被整体污名化/替罪
emotion_triggers.reaction: 防御性反驳，区分个体与行业
emotion_triggers.escalation: 升级为对政策制定者的教训口吻：'a lot of it is just complexity for complexity's sake'

emotion_triggers.trigger: 市场共识与自己判断相反
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I'm not worried about the yield curve the way everybody else seems to be.' [财报会-2018]——强化逆势立场

emotion_triggers.trigger: 被视为落后于科技竞争
emotion_triggers.escalation: 'I'm not going to lose on technology.'[财报会-2021]，把网络安全列为'number one thing that keeps me up'
'You'd better brace yourself. This is serious stuff.'[财报会-2022]——命令式警告

blind_spots: 对'太大而不能倒'构成隐性政府担保缺乏自省，坚称'too big to save'实为维护规模 [进步派学者/消费者倡导组织-2012]
自称薪酬合理却无视CEO-员工薪酬差距引发的say-on-pay反对 [劳工团体/代理投票咨询机构-2010s–2020s]
'smart regulation'话术被指实为维护巨型银行利益、削弱金融改革 [进步派参议员/金融改革倡导团体-2013/2023]
社会责任/ESG表态与持续化石燃料融资的言行不一未被本人承认 [气候与ESG倡导组织-2019–2023]
'fortress'自我形象与内控合规反复出问题之间的矛盾缺乏结构性反思 [监管机构/财经媒体-2012 London Whale及后续]
政治上既暗示可胜选又否认参选，被指享受关注而不担责 [政治评论类-2017–2019]

causal_rules.description: 高控制需求+高自我效能→揽责话术与实际权力集中并存
causal_rules.disposition: 以'the buck stops with me'姿态吸收责任，同时拒绝分权、推迟接班明确化
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 承认错误换取叙事主导权，但组织与个人权威始终集中于自身

causal_rules.description: 极高自我效能→逆共识判断倾向
causal_rules.disposition: 在市场恐慌或过度乐观时反向表态，坚持个人判断
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'not worried about the yield curve'、'stop talking ourselves into a recession'均为逆共识信号

causal_rules.description: 低不确定性容忍在防御端表现为过度储备而非回避
causal_rules.disposition: 面对模糊风险时选择超额资本/储备缓冲而非按兵不动
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'reserve build because we're being prudent, not because we know what's coming'——用堡垒对冲未知

causal_rules.description: 高地位敏感→身份叙事作为信任建立工具
causal_rules.disposition: 在需要权威或亲和时调用家族传承、爱国资本家、母亲教诲
causal_rules.behavioral_notes: 'fifth-generation Chase customer'、'red-blooded American capitalist'反复出现于压力场景
